name: gta
note: Weights for types seen in titles come from median views of 150 top GTA Shorts (YouTube Data API, 13 Nov 2026); a type with fewer than 5 matches keeps its earlier weight, and setup_payoff/stakes_early are hand-set. Views favour big channels, so treat this as a prior and re-weight from our own clips' views.

categories.description: A pursuit, escape or shootout with police, with the outcome visible.
A robbery, scam or plan that goes wrong in a way the viewer can follow.
Someone steals from, tricks or turns on another character.
Absurd character interaction: an argument, a bit that escalates, a stranger who will not play along.
A crash, ragdoll, stunt or game glitch that looks absurd.
A line or exchange that is funny without needing the rest of the stream.
A loud or visible reaction: shouting, laughter, disbelief.
A clear setup followed by a payoff inside the clip.
What is at risk is stated or visible in the first three seconds.

penalties.description: Makes no sense without the rest of the stream, or depends on a long running storyline.
Nothing happens in the first three seconds.
The moment is mostly about another streamer, which the brief bans.
